text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser gets injured during
training,
so I rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This is the kind of injury that puts a
hold
on
training for a while, huh? Mumuuun...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...You know,
I can deal with a little pain,
so do
you think it'd be okay if I train
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're right... It'd be dangerous to push myself...
choice_data_list: Let's take a pause so that you can...
Shall we explore what options we have?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All I can do right now is heal up quick...
I'll take
things easy today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser sounds
disappointed, but
returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's head back to the track right
away and
see if there isn't some exercise
I can still do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gyah... It's no use...
It starts hurting the
moment I
put pressure on it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I guess all I can do right now is rest... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser slowly returns to
the dorm
looking pained.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I think I'll be fine as long as I
don't break
into an all-out sprint!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I should be able to train like this until
I'm fully
healed! Oh, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser stays mindful of her
injury
and trains comfortably within her
limits.
